content: संमोह, संमोहक {%a.%} Infatuating, bewildering, fascinating; तपो हि परमं श्रेयः संमोहमितरत्सुखम् <ls>Rām. 7. 84. 9</ls>.
संमोहः .²1 Bewilderment, confusion, infatuation. .²2 Insensibility, swoon. .²3 Ignorance, folly; भ्रमं संमोहमावर्तमभ्यासाद्विनिवर्तयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 274. 7</ls>. .²4 Fascination. .²5 Tumult, battle.
